title: Incomplete hour rows (empty From or To) are ignored by the overlap check
permissions_required: Access to the Edit Location / Edit Staff Member settings screens. Confirm the exact permission live at VIU.
preconditions: 1. You are in the per-day working-hours editor with one complete range and one empty added range.
steps: 1. On one day, add a range but leave its From and/or To empty.
2. Look at the validation state and the Save button.
expected: 1. The incomplete row (empty From/To) is ignored by the overlap check - it does not raise the overlap error.
2. Save is not blocked by an incomplete row on its own (only genuine overlaps disable Save).
spec_ref: SV-8699 Working Hours Settings (§4.2 - incomplete rows ignored)
refs: SV-8699 (§4.2 Working Hours - incomplete rows ignored by overlap check)
